name: Interdimensional Dreamdates
source:
Congratulations, interdimensional student!

Study multiversal subjects, meet extraordinary classmates, and maybe even spark romance. The multiverse is waiting – walk through the portal and dive in!

[From [url=https://danidoo.itch.io/interdimensional-dreamdates]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
恭喜你，跨維度求學的新同學！

學習多元宇宙的課程，結識非同凡響的同窗，說不定還能擦出愛情的火花。多元宇宙正等著你——跨過傳送門，一頭扎進去吧！
